descriptions.normal: A soft, chewy candy featuring a blend of two distinct flavors. With a bit of practice, you can blow impressively massive bubbles! Just watch out — if you push it too far and the bubble pops, you'll end up with a face full of sticky goo!
descriptions.suspicious: A soft, chewy candy. You brave the mint's powerful chill, puff up your cheeks, and with great effort finally blow a tiny bubble. Then, just before success is within reach, it leaks with a few sad little pffts, and the whole attempt is ruined...
descriptions.delicious: A soft, chewy candy. Its fresh flavor glides smoothly down your throat, bringing an instantly cool and refreshing sensation. Better still, with a gentle puff, you can blow a clear, glossy bubble. A perfect little treat for passing the time!

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 1200 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 900 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 1500 HP.
